# HiAPI GPT Image 2.5 Agent Skill

HiAPI Agent Skill for GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst — default mode models `gpt-image-2.5-flare/text-to-image`, `gpt-image-2.5-flare/image-to-image`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst/text-to-image`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst/image-to-image`, plus the pro route `gpt-image-2.5-flare@pro` and `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst@pro`, priced by quality × framing × resolution (15 ratios or a WxH size, 1K/2K/4K, five quality values, server-computed framing) — covering AI image generation, image editing, preflight estimates, idempotent async tasks, recovery, and output download.

All six model IDs require prompts within 20,000 UTF-16 code units after trimming surrounding whitespace; longer prompts are rejected locally. Text-to-image also has an internal o200k token cap (`PROMPT_TOO_LONG`); image-to-image does not.

- [README](README.md): installation, scenarios, examples, and FAQ
- [Skill instructions](SKILL.md): invocation boundary and workflow
- [API contract](references/api.md): fields, enums, defaults, and a dated pricing snapshot
- [Output and recovery](references/output.md): polling, download, and QC
- [Agent installation](llms-install.md): local installer and planned public command
